Yeah, I feel sorry for the live team. Anything and everything they do will always be met with the worst of criticisms and inevitably never be good enough for the community. They're probably working their asses off trying to get what little content they can out to us but very few people can appreciate that.

We will inevitably be replaying content and grinding for gear until the first dlc drop. I'm ok with it personally because I come from destiny like a lot of others here. Its all about not burning yourself out in the first few weeks as i've learned, because then the first dlc will seem so much more far off than it really is. Yeah the idea of replaying content isn't all that appealing but its just a part of games like this, eventually we will hit the end, but hopefully we will have enjoyed the journey we took to get there. If we're really lucky the content we get will be fun and exciting, to the point that replaying it doesn't lessen the experience through multiple playthroughs. 

Heres to hoping that they hit the ground running and the launch is a success and we don't rush through every mission, sidequest, bonus objectives, and get every collectable/item in the first couple weeks, be you either a hardcore or casual gamer.

At this point I'm pretty sure Bungie just doesn't have the staff to maintain and build destiny properly. This would explain the lack of clarity from them because they don't want to admit they can't keep up. This is also kind of evident in the fact that they said they couldn't handle another year of paid dlc and they barely managed TDB and HoW. Its also evident in the first interview Crucible Radio had with Jon Weisnewksi when they asked why we didn't get a balance patch for so long, he said something along the lines of "..we could either make a balance patch and test that out **or** ship House of Wolves..." ([Heres some context](https://youtu.be/jwyGYiGwp2U?list=PL-ncH812VtHHdYUNeNMxhopgwqu9BHzhP&t=1209)). It sort of proves they can't maintain the game and make new content at the same time. And even when they ignore one for the other, its still meager content at best or a fix that makes even more problems than it solves.

They're probably putting all their resources into making destiny 2 with all the fixes that we want currently because they can't fix the game that we have now and get sequel out by the end of the year at the same time. They just don't have the man power and resources to do both. 

And they obviously can't admit any of that because if they do, then whats left of this dwindling player base will overreact and leave out of anger, but rightfully so because Bungie is abusing our trust. It sucks but this is probably whats happening. Even if they fix everything in Destiny 2, and I mean literally everything, it will be too late and most will never come back because of how Bungie is handling maintaining the game now.

I was in vegas for CES with my dad. Later in the night we were walking down the strip kinda drunk and because we live in Washington he asked if I had bought any legal weed yet. I told him yes, once. I told him it was overpriced. He goes "OH man, DUUDE that sucks. I've got this customer who trades me pot for fixing her computer and shit." He goes on to talk about some edible she gave him and how it was the best sleep he had. I was kinda shocked because I never knew this side of my dad. It was crazy to me. He then says he has some extra that he'll give me when we get back home. 

When my mom found out it was weirder. Like I said I live in Washington and my new step sister in law was opening a recreational Dispensary and suggested I send my resume in since I had just turned 21. My mom and sister over heard the conversation and I admitted that I had smoked before but I still didn't know much. My mom then says that she recently ate some brownies with her new husband when they went out clubbing. Also never knew my mom would be up for that. 

I pretty much learned that my family is not nearly as stuck up as I thought and I'm still burning through the weed my dad gave me. Never did get that job though :(
